guidance.name: Guidance computer and platform, aligned on the stars
guidance.why: Without it there is no guided entry: she flies a ballistic one, steep and hot, into the wrong ocean.

quads.name: Heaters for the thruster quads, before they're needed
quads.why: The thrusters have sat at deep cold for three days. Cold, they may not fire to hold her attitude in entry.

voice.name: One S-band radio for voice
voice.why: Without a voice link the ground cannot read up the entry numbers or hear what is wrong.

displays.name: The entry monitor and the flight displays
displays.why: The crew fly the entry on these.

telemetry.name: Full telemetry to the ground
telemetry.why: Without it the back room flies blind on the spacecraft until she is in the ocean.

early.name: Power up two hours early, for time to troubleshoot
early.why: If anything comes up wrong from cold, there is time to find it. Power up late and there is none.

cabin.name: The cabin heaters
cabin.why: The crew have been at about three degrees for days. It would be a mercy, and it is a lot of amp-hours.

TOPUP.name: Top up entry battery A from the lander's batteries
